description: This file defines a UI screen for an Android application built with Jetpack Compose. It manages the main tabbed interface shown after onboarding, including connection status, navigation between different tabs (Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, Settings), and related UI components such as status bars and bottom navigation bars.

classes.name: HomeTab
classes.description: Enumerates the main tabs in the bottom navigation bar, each with a label and icon.

classes.name: StatusVisual
classes.description: Represents the visual status indicator of the connection status.

methods.name: PostOnboardingTabs
methods.description: Main composable function displaying the tabbed navigation UI, handling state and navigation logic.

methods.name: ScreenTabScreen
methods.description: Displays the screen tab content, refreshing data when connected.

methods.name: TopStatusBar
methods.description: Shows the top status bar with connection status and labels.

methods.name: BottomTabBar
methods.description: Displays the bottom navigation bar with tabs and icons.
